460.subject: radio-telephony
460.title: South African Time to UTC
460.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "UTC = SOUTH AFRICAN LOCAL TIME − 2 HOURS", "subline": "SOUTH AFRICAN STANDARD TIME IS UTC+2 ALL YEAR (NO DAYLIGHT SAVING)", "blocks": [{"label": "LOCAL → UTC", "value": "Subtract 2 hours: 17:00 SAST = 15:00 UTC"}, {"label": "UTC → LOCAL", "value": "Add 2 hours: 06:30 UTC = 08:30 SAST"}]}

485.subject: radio-telephony
485.title: Flight Plan Item 10 — Equipment Code S
485.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "S = V + O + L: VHF RADIO, VOR AND ILS", "subline": "THE STANDARD COM/NAV/APPROACH FIT, NO MORE AND NO LESS", "blocks": [{"label": "V", "value": "VHF radiotelephony"}, {"label": "O", "value": "VOR"}, {"label": "L", "value": "ILS"}, {"label": "ANYTHING ELSE", "value": "Add its own letter, e.g. D for DME, F for ADF"}]}

506.subject: radio-telephony
506.title: Backtrack the Runway
506.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "BACKTRACK = TAXI ON THE RUNWAY AGAINST THE DIRECTION IN USE", "subline": "USED WHEN THERE IS NO PARALLEL TAXIWAY TO REACH THE THRESHOLD", "blocks": [{"label": "WHERE", "value": "On the active runway — follow the clearance exactly"}, {"label": "THEN", "value": "Turn around at the end and line up, or vacate, as cleared"}]}

518.subject: radio-telephony
518.title: Line Up and Wait
518.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "LINE UP AND WAIT: ENTER THE RUNWAY, LINE UP, DO NOT TAKE OFF", "subline": "IT IS NOT A TAKE-OFF CLEARANCE", "blocks": [{"label": "DO", "value": "Taxi onto the runway and line up on the centreline"}, {"label": "DON'T", "value": "Start the take-off roll until cleared for take-off"}, {"label": "READ BACK", "value": "'Lining up and waiting, runway 03'"}]}

2239.subject: flight-planning
2239.title: Figure 1-15 — Fuel to Descend Is a Difference
2239.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "READ THE CRUISE CONDITION AND THE DESTINATION CONDITION, THEN SUBTRACT", "subline": "THE DESCENT CHART IS CUMULATIVE FROM SEA LEVEL", "blocks": [{"label": "CRUISE", "value": "9000 ft at +16°C → about 4 USG"}, {"label": "DESTINATION", "value": "4000 ft at ISA (15 − 8 = +7°C) → about 2 USG"}, {"label": "FUEL TO DESCEND", "value": "4 − 2 = 2 USG"}], "formula": "Descent fuel = cruise reading − destination reading"}

2240.subject: flight-planning
2240.title: High Density Altitude Reduces Climb Performance
2240.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "HIGHER DENSITY ALTITUDE = THINNER AIR = POORER CLIMB", "subline": "HOT, HIGH AND LOW-PRESSURE DAYS ALL RAISE DENSITY ALTITUDE", "blocks": [{"label": "ENGINE", "value": "Less air mass per stroke, so less power"}, {"label": "PROPELLER", "value": "Less thrust from the thinner air"}, {"label": "WING", "value": "Higher TAS needed for the same lift; longer take-off and landing runs"}]}

2244.subject: flight-planning
2244.title: Maximum Ramp Weight
2244.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "MAXIMUM RAMP WEIGHT = MTOW + TAXI FUEL", "subline": "THE TAXI FUEL IS BURNED BEFORE THE TAKE-OFF ROLL STARTS", "blocks": [{"label": "ON THE RAMP", "value": "May exceed MTOW by the taxi fuel"}, {"label": "AT BRAKE RELEASE", "value": "Must be at or below MTOW"}]}

2247.subject: flight-planning
2247.title: Figure 1-22 — Distance to Clear 50 ft
2247.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "+15°C IS HALFWAY BETWEEN THE +10°C AND +20°C COLUMNS", "subline": "PA 4000 FT, TOTAL TO CLEAR 50 FT: 2185 FT AT +10°C AND 2345 FT AT +20°C", "blocks": [{"label": "ROW", "value": "Pressure altitude 4000 ft"}, {"label": "COLUMN", "value": "TOTAL TO CLEAR 50 FT (not ground roll)"}, {"label": "CORRECTIONS", "value": "No wind or grass correction is given, so none applies"}], "formula": "(2185 + 2345) ÷ 2 = 2265 ft"}

2250.subject: flight-planning
2250.title: Figure 1-16 — Glide Range From Height Above Terrain
2250.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "ENTER WITH THE HEIGHT AVAILABLE, NOT THE CRUISING ALTITUDE", "subline": "10 500 FT − 1500 FT TERRAIN = 9000 FT OF HEIGHT → ABOUT 19 NM", "blocks": [{"label": "HEIGHT AVAILABLE", "value": "Cruising pressure altitude − terrain pressure altitude"}, {"label": "READ", "value": "Across from 9000 ft to the glide line, then down to the NM scale"}, {"label": "CONDITIONS", "value": "Power off, flaps 0°, 75 KIAS, 2500 lb, zero wind"}]}

2252.subject: flight-planning
2252.title: Figure 1-23 — Endurance Between Two Altitudes
2252.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "PA 9000 FT IS HALFWAY BETWEEN THE 8000 FT AND 10 000 FT BLOCKS", "subline": "2400 RPM ENDURANCE: 6.8 H AT 8000 FT AND 7.6 H AT 10 000 FT", "blocks": [{"label": "READ", "value": "The 2400 RPM line in each altitude block, ENDURANCE column"}, {"label": "INTERPOLATE", "value": "(6.8 + 7.6) ÷ 2 = 7.2 hours"}, {"label": "NOTE", "value": "Based on 48 USG usable fuel, no reserve"}], "formula": "(6.8 + 7.6) ÷ 2 = 7.2 h"}

2254.subject: flight-planning
2254.title: VFE — Top of the White Arc
2254.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "VFE = MAXIMUM SPEED WITH FLAPS EXTENDED", "subline": "IT IS THE UPPER END OF THE WHITE ARC ON THE AIRSPEED INDICATOR", "blocks": [{"label": "WHITE ARC", "value": "Flap operating range: VS0 (bottom) to VFE (top)"}, {"label": "GREEN ARC", "value": "Normal operating range: VS1 to VNO"}, {"label": "YELLOW ARC / RED LINE", "value": "Caution range VNO to VNE; never exceed VNE"}]}

2255.subject: flight-planning
2255.title: Runway Slope
2255.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "SLOPE % = HEIGHT DIFFERENCE ÷ RUNWAY LENGTH × 100", "subline": "RUNWAY 18 RUNS FROM 5180 FT DOWN TO 5125 FT: 1.45% DOWN", "blocks": [{"label": "DIFFERENCE", "value": "5180 − 5125 = 55 ft"}, {"label": "SLOPE", "value": "55 ÷ 3800 × 100 = 1.45%"}, {"label": "DIRECTION", "value": "Runway 18 starts at the high end, so it slopes down"}], "formula": "55 ÷ 3800 × 100 = 1.45% down"}

2263.subject: flight-planning
2263.title: New CG After Adding Load
2263.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "NEW CG = TOTAL MOMENT ÷ TOTAL WEIGHT", "subline": "220 420 LB·IN ÷ 2405 LB = 91.65 IN", "blocks": [{"label": "MOMENTS", "value": "Weight × arm for each item, then add"}, {"label": "TOTAL WEIGHT", "value": "2200 + 175 + 30 = 2405 lb (within MAUW 2500 lb)"}, {"label": "CG MOVES AFT", "value": "Both new items sit well behind the old CG"}], "formula": "CG = 220 420 ÷ 2405 = 91.65 in"}

2264.subject: flight-planning
2264.title: Wind Shear on Final — Sudden Headwind Increase
2264.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "A SUDDEN HEADWIND INCREASE MAKES THE AIRCRAFT OVERSHOOT", "subline": "IAS AND LIFT JUMP, SO THE AIRCRAFT BALLOONS ABOVE THE GLIDE PATH", "blocks": [{"label": "HEADWIND ↑ (OR TAILWIND ↓)", "value": "IAS ↑ → lift ↑ → above the path → overshoot"}, {"label": "HEADWIND ↓ (OR TAILWIND ↑)", "value": "IAS ↓ → lift ↓ → below the path → undershoot"}, {"label": "RECOVERY", "value": "Smooth, positive corrections — don't chase the airspeed"}]}

2265.subject: flight-planning
2265.title: Fuel Volume to Mass
2265.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "CONVERT TO LITRES FIRST, THEN MULTIPLY BY THE SPECIFIC GRAVITY", "subline": "42 USG × 3.785 = 159 L; 159 L × 0.72 = 114 KG", "blocks": [{"label": "USG → LITRES", "value": "× 3.785"}, {"label": "LITRES → KG", "value": "× SG (kg per litre)"}, {"label": "CHECK", "value": "Fuel is lighter than water, so kg < litres"}], "formula": "kg = USG × 3.785 × SG"}

2267.subject: flight-planning
2267.title: Landing Distance Available
2267.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "LDA STARTS AT THE DISPLACED THRESHOLD AND ENDS AT THE RUNWAY END", "subline": "1150 − 25 = 1125 M — THE STOPWAY IS NEVER PART OF THE LDA", "blocks": [{"label": "DISPLACED THRESHOLD", "value": "Usable for take-off, not for landing"}, {"label": "STOPWAY", "value": "Counts towards ASDA only (decelerating after a rejected take-off)"}, {"label": "LDA", "value": "Runway length − displaced portion"}], "formula": "LDA = 1150 − 25 = 1125 m"}

2290.subject: flight-planning
2290.title: Figure 1-21 — Interpolating Between Weights
2290.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "2300 LB IS HALFWAY BETWEEN THE 2400 LB AND 2200 LB ROWS", "subline": "FLAPS 40°, 60° BANK: 60 KIAS AT 2400 LB AND 54 KIAS AT 2200 LB", "blocks": [{"label": "READ", "value": "KIAS column under 60° bank, on both flaps-40° rows"}, {"label": "INTERPOLATE", "value": "(60 + 54) ÷ 2 = 57 KIAS"}, {"label": "REMEMBER", "value": "Stall speed rises with weight and with angle of bank"}], "formula": "Stall speed = (60 + 54) ÷ 2 = 57 KIAS"}

2291.subject: flight-planning
2291.title: Figure 1-19 — Interpolating the Calibration Table
2291.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "77 KIAS LIES 7/10 OF THE WAY FROM 70 TO 80 — SO DOES THE KCAS", "subline": "FLAPS 40° ROW: 70 KIAS = 71 KCAS, 80 KIAS = 81 KCAS", "blocks": [{"label": "FRACTION", "value": "(77 − 70) ÷ (80 − 70) = 0.7"}, {"label": "APPLY", "value": "71 + 0.7 × (81 − 71) = 71 + 7 = 78 KCAS"}], "formula": "KCAS = 71 + 0.7 × 10 = 78 KCAS"}

2300.subject: flight-planning
2300.title: Aquaplaning and Groundspeed
2300.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "AQUAPLANING IS MORE LIKELY AT HIGH GROUNDSPEED", "subline": "THE TYRE CAN'T PUSH THE WATER AWAY FAST ENOUGH AND RIDES ON A FILM", "blocks": [{"label": "RISK UP WITH", "value": "Speed, standing water, worn tread, low tyre pressure"}, {"label": "EFFECT", "value": "Braking and steering are lost while the tyre is off the surface"}, {"label": "RULE OF THUMB", "value": "Aquaplaning speed (kt) ≈ 9 × √tyre pressure (psi)"}]}

2305.subject: flight-planning
2305.title: Figure 1-7 — Reading the Rate of Climb
2305.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "ENTER AT THE TEMPERATURE, UP TO THE ALTITUDE, ACROSS, THEN DOWN", "subline": "OAT +10°C AT PRESSURE ALTITUDE 4000 FT GIVES ABOUT 540 FT/MIN", "blocks": [{"label": "STEP 1", "value": "Enter the OAT scale at +10°C and go up to the 4000 ft pressure-altitude line"}, {"label": "STEP 2", "value": "Go straight across to the rate-of-climb line"}, {"label": "STEP 3", "value": "Drop down to the RATE OF CLIMB scale: about 540 ft/min"}]}

2312.subject: flight-planning
2312.title: Figure 1-8 — Distance to Climb Is a Difference
2312.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "THE CHART IS CUMULATIVE FROM SEA LEVEL: READ TWICE AND SUBTRACT", "subline": "TOP-OF-CLIMB READING MINUS THE DEPARTURE READING", "blocks": [{"label": "DEPARTURE", "value": "PA = 1380 + (1013 − 1009) × 30 = 1500 ft at +12°C → about 4 NM"}, {"label": "CRUISE", "value": "PA 7500 ft, ISA+12 = 0 + 12 = +12°C → about 24 NM"}, {"label": "CLIMB DISTANCE", "value": "24 − 4 ≈ 20 NM"}], "formula": "Climb distance = cruise reading − departure reading"}

2320.subject: flight-planning
2320.title: Figure 1-22 — Ground Roll With a Tailwind
2320.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "INTERPOLATE FIRST, THEN APPLY THE WIND NOTE", "subline": "TAILWIND: +10% FOR EACH 2 KT, SO 4 KT ADDS 20%", "blocks": [{"label": "ROW", "value": "PA 3500 ft is halfway between 3000 ft and 4000 ft"}, {"label": "GROUND ROLL AT +20°C", "value": "(1190 + 1310) ÷ 2 = 1250 ft"}, {"label": "TAILWIND 4 KT", "value": "1250 × 1.20 = 1500 ft"}], "formula": "1250 × 1.20 = 1500 ft"}

2332.subject: flight-planning
2332.title: Total Fuel Required — Build It Up
2332.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "TOTAL FUEL = TAXI/TAKE-OFF/CLIMB + CRUISE + RESERVE", "subline": "3 + 8.37 + 8 = 19.4 USG", "blocks": [{"label": "TIME", "value": "107 NM ÷ 92 kt = 1.163 h (69.8 min)"}, {"label": "CRUISE FUEL", "value": "1.163 h × 7.2 USG/h = 8.37 USG"}, {"label": "ADD", "value": "3 USG taxi/take-off/climb + 8 USG reserve"}], "formula": "3 + 8.37 + 8 = 19.4 USG"}

2337.subject: flight-planning
2337.title: Figure 1-23 — True Airspeed Between Two Altitudes
2337.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "PA 7000 FT IS HALFWAY BETWEEN THE 6000 FT AND 8000 FT BLOCKS", "subline": "2600 RPM: 123 KTAS AT 6000 FT AND 119 KTAS AT 8000 FT", "blocks": [{"label": "READ", "value": "The 2600 RPM line in each altitude block, KTAS column"}, {"label": "INTERPOLATE", "value": "(123 + 119) ÷ 2 = 121 KTAS"}], "formula": "(123 + 119) ÷ 2 = 121 KTAS"}

2342.subject: flight-planning
2342.title: VX vs VY
2342.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "VX = BEST ANGLE OF CLIMB; VY = BEST RATE OF CLIMB", "subline": "VX GIVES THE MOST HEIGHT PER DISTANCE; VY THE MOST HEIGHT PER MINUTE", "blocks": [{"label": "VX", "value": "Use to clear an obstacle close to the runway"}, {"label": "VY", "value": "Use for the normal climb to cruising altitude"}, {"label": "SPEEDS", "value": "VX is lower than VY"}]}

2355.subject: flight-planning
2355.title: Moment = Weight × Arm
2355.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "MOMENT = WEIGHT × ARM", "subline": "THE TURNING EFFECT OF A WEIGHT ABOUT THE DATUM", "blocks": [{"label": "ARM", "value": "Distance from the datum to the item's CG (inches)"}, {"label": "MOMENT", "value": "Weight × arm (lb·in)"}, {"label": "CG", "value": "Total moment ÷ total weight"}], "formula": "CG = Σ moments ÷ Σ weights"}

2363.subject: flight-planning
2363.title: Landing Behind a Heavy Aircraft
2363.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "TOUCH DOWN BEYOND THE HEAVY AIRCRAFT'S TOUCHDOWN POINT", "subline": "WAKE VORTICES STOP ONCE THE HEAVY AIRCRAFT'S WEIGHT IS ON THE RUNWAY", "blocks": [{"label": "APPROACH", "value": "Stay at or above the heavy aircraft's flight path"}, {"label": "TOUCHDOWN", "value": "Land beyond the point where it touched down"}, {"label": "VORTICES", "value": "Sink below the path and drift with the wind"}]}

2374.subject: flight-planning
2374.title: Density Altitude — Worked Example
2374.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "DENSITY ALTITUDE ≈ 4560 FT", "subline": "THE AEROPLANE PERFORMS AS IF IT WERE 1350 FT HIGHER THAN THE AERODROME", "blocks": [{"label": "PRESSURE ALTITUDE", "value": "3210 + (1013 − 1020) × 30 = 3000 ft"}, {"label": "ISA DEVIATION", "value": "ISA at 3000 ft = 15 − 6 = +9°C, so 22 − 9 = +13°C"}, {"label": "DENSITY ALTITUDE", "value": "3000 + 120 × 13 = 4560 ft"}], "formula": "DA = PA + 120 × (OAT − ISA temp)"}

2389.subject: flight-planning
2389.title: Figure 1-24 — Landing Distance in Two Steps
2389.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "CONVERT TO PRESSURE ALTITUDE, THEN INTERPOLATE ALTITUDE AND TEMPERATURE", "subline": "PA = 2650 + (1013 − 1018) × 30 = 2500 FT", "blocks": [{"label": "PA 2500 FT", "value": "Halfway row: 1367.5 ft at +20°C and 1402.5 ft at +30°C"}, {"label": "+24°C", "value": "0.4 of the way from +20°C to +30°C"}, {"label": "RESULT", "value": "1367.5 + 0.4 × 35 = 1381.5 ≈ 1382 ft"}], "formula": "1367.5 + 0.4 × 35 ≈ 1382 ft"}
